title: Voice of the System
narrative: The silver mirror reflects only darkness. It cannot read your thoughts — it can only repeat what you place inside print(). Speak your name, and then your health.
instructions:
Your character's own values are already in the chests:

```python
player_name = "{{player_name}}"
hp = {{hp}}
```

Your task:
- Print `player_name` to the mirror
- Then print `hp` to the mirror

Expected output:
```
{{player_name}}
{{hp}}
```
starting_code:
player_name = "{{player_name}}"
hp = {{hp}}

hints: Use print() to display a value: print(player_name)
Call print() twice — once for player_name, once for hp.
Do not put quotes around the variable name. print(player_name) opens the chest; print("player_name") just shows the words.
